title: AVP - Java Developer - Equity Technology
description:
**Job Description**
**Innovation Hub Overview**
Jefferies is creating a Technology Innovation Hub in Pune, a greenfield opportunity to build the systems that power global markets. As our first India technology center, this hub brings together hands on builders who engineer the platforms behind Jefferies’ growth across capital markets, investment banking, and institutional securities. We’re scaling toward an elite team of 500 engineers while maintaining the agility, ownership, and meritocratic spirit that defines Jefferies. From cloud and data to AI, risk, and core business technologies, teams in Pune will lead high impact work with a global mandate.
  
  
**IT Equities Technology**
Jefferies’ Equities Technology team builds and runs global, real-time trading and risk platforms across the full equities product spectrum—cash equities, portfolio/algo trading, central risk books, listed & OTC derivatives, convertibles, swaps, and ETF/basket trading. The team supports front-office workflows end-to-end, including order management, quantitative trading, real-time position and risk, AI/ML analytics, trade lifecycle processing, and regulatory/customer reporting.
  
  
Operating in a 24x7 follow-the-sun model across major trading hubs, the India Technology Innovation Hub will be a core engineering center working closely with New York, London, Hong Kong, and other regions to build and enhance high-performance, scalable systems using technologies such as Python, Java, C++/C#, cloud, modern visualization, low-latency messaging, and in-memory data stores.
  
  
**About The Role**
Jefferies’ Equities – Prime Services Technology team is seeking a technically strong and motivated Java Developer to join the Securities Finance technology group in Pune. This role will focus on the design, development, enhancement, and support of strategic trading and servicing systems used by a global Securities Finance user base. You will collaborate closely with cross-regional technology teams in Hong Kong, London, and New York to build foundational and functional components of the Securities Finance product suite.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and enhance applications and services using Java and the Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot preferred).
* Design, build, test, deploy, and support core Securities Finance components with a focus on scalability, performance, and resilience.
* Contribute to building distributed systems and enterprise-grade services (APIs, messaging, batch/stream processing as applicable).
* Work with global teams to deliver features, fixes, and platform improvements across time zones.
* Participate in code reviews, unit/integration testing, and release activities.
* Diagnose production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement sustainable fixes.
* Continuously improve architecture, engineering practices, automation, and observability.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of hands-on development experience with Core Java and Spring frameworks.
* Experience delivering distributed systems and enterprise-grade applications in production.
* Strong knowledge of SQL; experience with Redis and Kafka.
* Familiarity with AWS services such as EKS, EC2, S3, SQS, and SNS.
* Experience with SDLC and tooling including Jira, Bitbucket, and Bamboo.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted development; proficiency using GitHub Copilot to improve productivity and code quality.

**Preferred Qualifications (Good To Have)**

* Experience with Python development.
* Familiarity with Airflow, Snowflake, and AWS QuickSight.
* Exposure to financial services, Securities Finance, Prime Services, or trading systems.

**About Us**
Jefferies is a leading global, full-service investment banking and capital markets firm that provides advisory, sales and trading, research, and wealth and asset management services. With more than 40 offices around the world, we offer insights and expertise to investors, companies, and governments.
  
  
At Jefferies, we believe that diversity fosters creativity, innovation and thought leadership through the infusion of new ideas and perspectives. We have made a commitment to building a culture that provides opportunities for all employees regardless of our differences and supports a workforce that is reflective of the communities where we work and live. As a result, we are able to pool our collective insights and intelligence to provide fresh and innovative thinking for our clients.
  
  
Jefferies is an equal employment opportunity employer, and takes affirmative action to ensure that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, gender, pregnancy, age, physical or mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, genetic information, reproductive health decisions, or any other factor protected by applicable law. We are committed to hiring the most qualified applicants and complying with all federal, state, and local equal employment opportunity laws. As part of this commitment, Jefferies will extend reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities, as required by applicable law.

* Familiarity with data platforms (e.g., Hadoop, Spark, or Databricks/Snowflake) is a plus.

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

title: Founding Engineer - AI Systems & Product Engineering
description:
Company: Ve – The Intent Company

Location: Hyderabad, Telangana, India (Hybrid)

Experience: Minimum 4 years

Employment: Full-time

Role: Individual Contributor — End-to-End Engineering Ownership

**About Ve**

At Ve, we're building a new generation of AI-native software that fundamentally changes how people interact with computers, intelligence, and technology.

We believe the future of software won't simply respond to instructions. It will understand intent, reason through complex problems, take action, and help people accomplish things that previously seemed impossible.

We're a small, deeply technical team building at the frontier of artificial intelligence, autonomous agents, and human-computer interaction.

We're not interested in building another AI wrapper.

We're interested in building systems that redefine what software can do.

**The Opportunity**

We're looking for exceptional Founding Engineers who want to build ambitious technology from the ground up.This is not a conventional software engineering role.

You won't be joining a large team where responsibilities are narrowly divided and someone else makes all the important decisions.You'll work directly with the founder and a small group of highly capable engineers.You'll have significant ownership over architecture, implementation, performance, reliability, and the final product experience.We need engineers who can take a difficult problem, figure out the right approach, build it, ship it, and make sure it actually works. Not just people who write code. People who own outcomes.

**What You'll Own**

* End-to-end engineering: Take complex features and systems from initial concept through architecture, implementation, deployment, and production.
* AI-native systems: Build intelligent agents, orchestration systems, model integrations, and autonomous workflows.
* Product engineering: Develop fast, intuitive, reliable experiences across desktop applications, backend services, and AI-powered interfaces.
* Systems architecture: Design scalable, maintainable systems capable of supporting sophisticated, long-running AI operations.
* Performance engineering: Identify bottlenecks, optimize execution, reduce latency, and continuously improve system efficiency.
* Reliability and quality: Build robust error handling, observability, testing, recovery, and verification into everything you ship.
* Technical decisions: Evaluate trade-offs, challenge assumptions, and independently choose the right technologies and approaches.
* Production ownership: Debug difficult problems, investigate failures, and take responsibility for keeping your systems working.

You'll be expected to understand the bigger picture, not just your assigned component.

**What We're Looking For**

**Minimum Requirements**

* At least 4 years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping real products.
* Exceptional programming ability in at least one modern language such as TypeScript, Python, Rust, Go, or C++.
* Strong fundamentals in computer science, algorithms, data structures, concurrency, and systems design.
* Experience designing, building, and maintaining complex production systems.
* Strong understanding of APIs, distributed systems, databases, and asynchronous architectures.
* Ability to work across frontend, backend, infrastructure, and integrations when needed.
* Excellent debugging skills and the ability to understand unfamiliar codebases quickly.
* Experience making architectural decisions and understanding their long-term consequences.
* Strong engineering judgment around performance, reliability, scalability, and security.
* Ability to work independently, move quickly, and deliver production-ready solutions.

**Especially Valuable**

* Experience building AI agents, coding agents, or LLM-powered products.
* Experience with Claude, Codex, OpenAI, or other model APIs and agent harnesses.
* Understanding of agent orchestration, parallel execution, tool calling, memory, and context management.
* Experience with Electron, Chromium, desktop applications, or native macOS development.
* Experience building developer tools, IDEs, CLIs, or code intelligence systems.
* Experience with AWS, cloud infrastructure, containers, and distributed execution.
* Contributions to meaningful open-source projects.
* Experience building products from zero to one.

You don't need to know every technology we use.

But you must be exceptionally good at learning, reasoning, and building.

**The Kind of Engineer Who Will Thrive Here**

You are deeply curious about how things work.

You don't stop at the first solution. You ask whether there's a fundamentally better way to solve the problem.

You care about speed, but never confuse writing code quickly with building something correctly.

You can navigate large, unfamiliar systems and identify the real cause of difficult problems.

You don't need detailed specifications for every decision.

You take initiative, investigate independently, and make things happen.

You care about the quality of what ships.

You don't consider a task complete because the code compiles, a pull request is merged, or a demo looks good.

You consider it complete when the intended outcome works reliably in the real product.

You're comfortable taking responsibility, receiving direct feedback, and working in an environment where expectations are extremely high.

You want to build something important, not simply complete tickets.

**How We Work**

We're a small team with an unusually ambitious technical vision.

We move fast. We experiment constantly. We challenge existing approaches and aren't afraid to rebuild something when we discover a better architecture.

Engineers have significant freedom, but that freedom comes with responsibility.

We expect you to think independently, communicate clearly, collaborate closely, and own the quality of your work.

We use AI extensively in our engineering process.

But we believe the most valuable engineers are those who can exercise exceptional judgment- understanding what to build, how to build it, why it works, and whether it actually solves the problem.

AI can accelerate implementation. Engineering judgment is what makes the result exceptional.

**What Success Looks Like**

Within your first 90 days, we expect you to:

1. Develop a deep understanding of Ve's architecture, product, and technical direction.
2. Independently take ownership of important engineering systems or product capabilities.
3. Ship meaningful improvements that users can experience.
4. Improve the performance, reliability, and maintainability of the systems you own.
5. Identify technical weaknesses and proactively solve them.
6. Become someone the team can trust with complex, ambiguous engineering challenges.

Over time, we want you to become a defining technical contributor to the company.

**Why Join Ve?**

Because you want to build technology that doesn't already exist.

You'll work directly with the founder, influence fundamental architectural decisions, and help shape a product from its earliest stages.

You'll have the opportunity to work on some of the most interesting problems in AI-native computing - intelligent agents, autonomous execution, developer tools, and new forms of human-computer interaction.

No unnecessary engineering bureaucracy.

No narrowly defined responsibilities.

No endless layers of approvals.

Just difficult problems, talented people, real ownership, and the opportunity to build something extraordinary.

We're looking for engineers who want to do the most important work of their careers.

**How to Apply**

Please share:

* Your GitHub profile or examples of meaningful technical work.
* The most complex system you've personally designed and built.
* A difficult engineering problem you solved independently.
* One example of something you've shipped and owned in production.
* Why you're interested in building AI-native software at Ve.

We're far more interested in what you've actually built than where you've worked.

Minimum 4 years of experience. Exceptional engineering ability. Complete ownership.

Avalara’s Content Engineering platform supports the compliance content that helps customers manage complex obligations across jurisdictions and product lines. The Machine Learning Engineer V owns complex AI systems from architecture through production, including full-stack application integration, backend services, agent orchestration, model and agent evaluation, deployment, observability, support, and ongoing improvement.
  
  
This is not a pure machine learning operations role. This role requires a senior engineer who builds agentic systems, integrates them with mainstream applications, applies sound software development life cycle practices, and operates production AI capabilities as secure, reliable, scalable product systems. This role sits within Content Engineering team and you will be reporting to Senior Manager, ML Engineering. This is a role.
  
  
**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**

* Build end-to-end AI-enabled systems that include backend services, application programming interfaces, data access patterns, agent orchestration, retrieval, tool integration, user-facing application components, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and production support.

* Strong software engineering skills in Python and experience designing backend services, application programming interfaces, distributed systems, and cloud-native platforms.
* Full-stack engineering experience across backend services, application programming interfaces, relational databases, scalable data access patterns, frontend-backend contracts, authentication, and modern web technologies.
* Experience applying the software development life cycle end to end, including requirements analysis, architecture, design, implementation, testing, release planning, deployment, monitoring, incident response, support, and continuous improvement.

* Experience with cloud-native systems, asynchronous or distributed workflows, observability, monitoring, deployment automation, and production operations.
* Ability to design for security, access control, governance, compliance, reliability, maintainability, resiliency, and cost efficiency.
* Strong system design skills and ability to lead technically complex initiatives across multiple stakeholders.
* Ability to mentor engineers, lead design reviews, and raise technical standards across teams.

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.

* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

Total Rewards
  
  
In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
